journey.name: Mark Episode as Played
journey.description: Verifies marking an unplayed episode as played from the episode options menu.

actions.action: Verify that the app is on the Home screen and episodes are visible.
Tap the three-dots menu icon on an episode in the list.
Verify that the episode options bottom sheet is open.
Verify that the episode is marked as played and removed from the active unplayed list.
